description: Change a post's words, hashtags, link, day, time, its picture or video (from the Library), or the angle its words take. Send only what changes. Returns the post with schedule_check: what Schedule would decide now. A post already scheduled can be changed only with the schedule permission; one already handed to its platform's own schedule (Facebook, YouTube) or one that went out cannot be changed here.

angle.description: Which of Audora's post angles the words take (the key names it: listener_pov is the listener's side of the song, tail_section a part of the track no other post used, hook_object an object the song names, and so on). Audora counts how each angle does for the artist, and promo_results' what_works shows the result. get_campaign shows each post's angle.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

caption.description: The words of the post, as they will be published. The lane's limit and Audora's text rules apply (no placeholders, nothing that points back at another post).

date.description: The day it goes out, YYYY-MM-DD, inside the campaign's window and not in the past.

dry_run.description: True to check the call and see what it would do, without writing anything.

hashtags.description: Up to 12 hashtags, with or without #. Replaces the list.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

link_url.description: A web address the post links to, or null to remove it.

media_asset_id.description: A picture (for a picture post) or a video (for a video post) already in the artist's Library, by its media asset id. Audora does not make pictures or videos through this connection.

post_id.description: The post's id (post_id from get_campaign or promo_this_week).

time.description: The time it goes out, HH:MM 24-hour, in the artist's own time zone.

name: update_post
title: Change a post
